message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "R&D Acceleration", "construction": "Year-over-year change in R&D expenditure (Compustat item XRD) as a percentage of total assets (AT), calculated as: [(XRD_t / AT_t) - (XRD_{t-1} / AT_{t-1})].", "rationale": "Firms accelerating investment in research may signal future growth opportunities ahead of observable results.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Earnings Season Momentum", "construction": "Cumulative stock return from the day before the most recent quarterly earnings announcement to 10 trading days after the announcement.", "rationale": "Stocks with strong post-earnings drift may be underreacted to by the market, offering return continuation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Unusual Inventory Change", "construction": "Absolute value of percentage change in inventory (Compustat INVT) from previous fiscal year, divided by sales (SALE): |(INVT_t - INVT_{t-1}) / SALE_t|.", "rationale": "Large, atypical inventory changes may precede significant business developments not yet incorporated in price.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Option Exercise Ratio", "construction": "Number of insider option exercises minus insider option grants over the past year, divided by total shares outstanding (from SEC Form 4 filings and Compustat CSHO).", "rationale": "A high net exercise rate may signal insider confidence about future stock performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Exposure", "construction": "Sum of customer-specific revenues divided by total revenues, for customers accounting for >10% of sales (from 10-K segment disclosures).", "rationale": "Firms reliant on a few customers may face undiversified demand risk, which could be incorrectly priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Expense Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year growth rate of SG&A expenses per employee, computed as (SGA_t / EMP_t) - (SGA_{t-1} / EMP_{t-1}), using Compustat SGA and EMP.", "rationale": "Rapid growth in per-employee expense may signal competition for talent and possible future profit pressure.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Delayed Dividend Initiation", "construction": "Years since IPO before first dividend payment (CRSP IPO date, Compustat DV initiation), for firms that recently started paying dividends.", "rationale": "Firms that wait longer before initiating dividends may do so only after strong, sustainable cash flow is established.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Shareholder Proposal Intensity", "construction": "Count of shareholder proposals submitted in the last proxy season, normalized by market capitalization (from SEC DEF 14A filings and CRSP market cap).", "rationale": "Firms targeted by frequent proposals may face governance headwinds that impede performance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Payment Stretch", "construction": "Change in days payable outstanding (DPO: Accounts Payable/AP divided by Cost of Goods Sold/COGS times 365) over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms increasing payment duration may be managing liquidity stress, raising risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Momentum", "construction": "Year-over-year growth in forward patent citations received by a firm’s patents, normalized by total assets (patent data from USPTO and Compustat AT).", "rationale": "Rising citations may indicate increasing technological relevance not yet reflected in market value.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
